faqs.a:
The following words, terms, and phrases, when used in this chapter, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
Nuisance
means any condition prohibited by this article, or by
Chapter 3
of the International Property Maintenance Code (I.P.M.C.). In addition, those offenses
               which are known to the common law of the land and the state statutes as nuisances
               shall also be considered nuisances under this code.
Nuisance property
means any structure, premises, lot, or real property that is determined to have any
               nuisance or nuisance condition within or upon it.
(
Ord. No. 4095, § 2, 11-19-2007
)
